Body.Content:
Blueprint Builder lets makers define a reusable, AI-driven planning experience in Sales Research Agent - the starter prompt, sections, data sources, narratives, and visualizations - and save it as a custom blueprint that runs across every account, portfolio, and territory.

What's new

Author a blueprint as an ordered layout of blocks: narrative sections, visualizations, data-driven areas, and deep-research areas.

Ground each block in Dataverse, Dynamics 365 Sales, Fabric Lakehouse, or a business function.

Generate, refine, publish, and share blueprints across teams.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
